r2-frame: R2 frame-preserving baseline: make each text self-contained with attribution, uncertainty, questions, corrections and unknown references. Keep original language; do not depend on metadata.
decompose: First enumerate source-supported propositions, then test independent truth variation and reconstruct each with its full frame. Audit scope before and after splitting.
english-intermediate: Internally decompose through English representations, then reconstruct final Claims in each ORIGINAL source-span language. Compare every intermediate representation against ORIGINAL Korean; translation is not evidence.
atomicity-review: Use decomposition and frame reconstruction; a separate atomicity reviewer follows.
fidelity-review: Use decomposition and frame reconstruction; a separate fidelity reviewer follows.
audited: Enumerate communicative structure and original propositions; decompose and reconstruct frames, conservative references/time, then audit the complete batch. Independent atomicity, fidelity and coverage reviewers follow.
